name: webgrip-infrastructure-release-toolchain
description: Locked release toolchain for every image train in this repo, not a publishable package. Installed by .forgejo/actions/semantic-release-monorepo via `npm ci` at the repo root, so ops/docker/<image>/.releaserc.cjs resolves one deterministic tree. @webgrip/semantic-release-config 2.x builds the per-image trains itself and releases by tag alone (homelab ADR-0078). The `overrides` block mirrors @webgrip/semantic-release-config's own, verbatim: it is the only npm mechanism that can force the notes-toolchain pair (generator 15.0.0-beta.2 / analyzer 14.0.0-beta.3 sit outside semantic-release's ranges, and a nested stable copy produces empty release notes, runs 426-435). Keep the overrides in lockstep with the config's package.json when either moves.
